papers.venue: The Cambridge Handbook of Methods in Conversation Analysis

papers.title: ConvoFusion: Multi-Modal Conversational Diffusion for Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis
papers.summary: A latent diffusion model for gestures from audio and text with guidance objectives that control the weight of each modality and emphasise chosen words, trained for monologue or conversational gestures.

papers.title: A Toolbox of Methods for Gesture Analysis
papers.venue: The Cambridge Handbook of Gesture Studies

papers.title: From Audio to Photoreal Embodiment: Synthesizing Humans in Conversations
papers.summary: An autoregressive VQ transformer predicts coarse guide poses from speech audio and a diffusion model fills in face, body and hand detail for a photoreal avatar in dyadic conversation.

papers.title: Early or synchronized gestures facilitate speech recall—a study based on motion capture data
Audio2AB: Audio-driven collaborative generation of virtual character animation
papers.summary: A network that takes audio, its transcript, emotion labels and semantic relevance labels and generates gesture animation plus 52 facial blendshape weights, trained with a GAN-based loss.

papers.title: Generating Interaction Behavior During a Dyadic Conversation Using a Diffusion Model
papers.latency: approximately 30 ms to generate expert-like motion
papers.summary: An interaction diffusion model that considers all conversation participants at once and uses feature masking for conditional generation of interaction behaviour, applied to an expert's gesture.

papers.title: Is vision necessary for the timely acquisition of language‐specific patterns in co‐speech gesture and their lack in silent gesture?
Speech and gesture alignment in immersive communication: Human-Human vs. Human-Computer interaction
Towards a novel conceptualization of prosody that accounts for spoken and visual signals
Design and Implementation of a Storytelling Robot: Preliminary Evaluation of a GAN-Based Model for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Implements a GAN-based model that generates co-speech gestures from text and audio features for a Pepper robot telling stories, and evaluates it with 18 participants.

papers.title: EmotionGesture: Audio-Driven Diverse Emotional Co-Speech 3D Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Generates emotional upper-body gestures from audio, transcript timing, emotion labels and an initial pose with a transformer and an emotion-conditioned VAE.
papers.notes: Also reports emotion accuracy (EA). Introduces a TED Emotion dataset.

papers.title: Weakly-Supervised Emotion Transition Learning for Diverse 3D Co-speech Gesture Generation
papers.summary: A transformer encoder-decoder with a motion discriminator and a VAE keyframe sampler generates gestures across emotion transitions from audio, trained with weak supervision from a learned mixed emotion label.
papers.notes: Introduces emotion-transition datasets BEAT-ETrans and TED-ETrans.

papers.title: Dual-Path Transformer-Based GAN for Co-speech Gesture Synthesis
papers.summary: Fuses gesture-related cues with parallel directional cross-modal transformers and a cascaded 2D attention module in an end-to-end GAN, and proposes metrics for gesture diversity and speech-gesture correspondence that need no 3D pose annotation.

papers.title: A Study on Integrating Representational Gestures into Automatically Generated Embodied Explanations
papers.summary: An embodied agent explains a board game using LLM-generated utterances, beat gestures from a graph-based speech-driven synthesis module and manually captured iconic gestures, evaluated for effects on understanding and interaction quality.

papers.title: Multimodality and contingency teaching
papers.venue: Multimodality across Epistemologies in Second Language Research

papers.title: Evaluation of co-speech gestures grounded in word-distributed representation
papers.summary: Robot gestures are generated from a word's size score computed along an axis in a word-distributed representation, mapped to either amount of movement or posture, and rated for naturalness in an online survey.
papers.notes: Uses Japanese Wikipedia word2vec vectors and Japanese WordNet on a Sota robot; computation reported as about 0.59 s per word on a MacBook Pro M1.

papers.title: PIDM: Personality-Aware Interaction Diffusion Model for Gesture Generation
Personality Expression Using Co-Speech Gesture
papers.summary: Framework that applies heuristics-based motion adjustments to generated co-speech gestures to express the Five-Factor personality traits in virtual agents.

papers.title: Beyond Talking – Generating Holistic 3D Human Dyadic Motion for Communication
papers.summary: Separate VQ-VAEs for speaker and listener holistic motion, with a chain-like autoregressive transformer that generates both roles' SMPL-X motion from audio and text.
papers.notes: Introduces the HoCo dataset (about 45 hours of YouTube conversations with pseudo-ground-truth SMPL-X). Other metrics: concordance correlation coefficient, time-lagged cross correlation.

papers.title: Your body tells how you engage in collaboration: Machine‐detected body movements as indicators of engagement in collaborative math knowledge building
Gesture Generation from Trimodal Context for Humanoid Robots
papers.summary: Reproduces a trimodal (audio, text, speaker identity) gesture generation model and maps its 3D poses to joint angles on a Pepper robot.
papers.notes: Motion variance is reported alongside FGD. A DOI for a published version is listed in the candidate metadata, but the venue could not be read, so the record stays as the preprint.

papers.title: The cognitive-emotional dialectics in second language development: speech and co-speech gestures of Chinese learners of English
papers.venue: IRAL - International Review of Applied Linguistics in Language Teaching

papers.title: Speech-driven expressive gesture generation for virtual agents
Gesture Area Coverage to Assess Gesture Expressiveness and Human-Likeness
authors: Leonardo B. de M. M. Marques
papers.summary: Proposes metrics based on the spatial area covered by gestures in a motion sequence and compares them with human-likeness ratings from the GENEA Challenge 2023.
papers.notes: Metrics are based on Gesture Area Coverage, including the Dice Score.

papers.title: Comparative Analysis on Speech Driven Gesture Generation
papers.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science

papers.title: Characterizing iconic gesture during storytelling in chronic TBI recovery
The effects of learning sign language on co-speech gesture
papers.venue: Digital Repository (National Repository of Grey Literature)

papers.title: Cross-Modal Quantization for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Jointly learns quantized codebooks for speech and gesture with a cross-modal quantizer, then autoregressively predicts the next-step gesture from the learned codes.

papers.title: Optimized Conversational Gesture Generation with Enhanced Motion Feature Extraction and Cascaded Generator
Gesture Evaluation in Virtual Reality
papers.summary: Compares ratings of gestures from three GENEA 2023 Challenge systems viewed in virtual reality against standard 2D video in a user study.

papers.title: Arm movements increase acoustic markers of expiratory flow
LLAniMAtion: LLAMA Driven Gesture Animation
papers.summary: A Transformer-XL gesture model conditioned on Llama2 text features, compared with and combined with audio features, to generate full-body gesture.
papers.notes: Also reports Frechet kinetic distance.

papers.title: Exploring the Effectiveness of Evaluation Practices for Computer-Generated Nonverbal Behaviour
papers.summary: Compares two direct rating methods and a new questionnaire for evaluating generated gesturing and listening motion in six user studies, using output of two generative models and recorded human motion.

papers.title: Speech-Driven Gesture Generation Using Transformer-Based Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
papers.summary: A transformer-based denoising diffusion model generates co-speech gestures including finger movements for short speech segments, with a sampling trick to keep consecutive segments continuous.

papers.title: EGGesture: Entropy-Guided Vector Quantized Variational AutoEncoder for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Co-speech gesture generation with a VQ-VAE whose codebook usage is balanced by a differentiable entropy term that also weights the codebook-index classification loss.

papers.title: Chain of Generation: Multi-Modal Gesture Synthesis via Cascaded Conditional Control
papers.summary: Generates facial blendshapes, then body movement, then hand gestures in a cascade from speech, using rhythm cues from facial motion and a speech-emotion style prior as conditions.
papers.notes: Experiments use the English part of BEAT.

papers.title: LLM Knows Body Language, Too: Translating Speech Voices into Human Gestures
papers.summary: GesTran encodes gestures into discrete tokens with a transformer auto-encoder, then fine-tunes a pre-trained LLM (LLaMA, via LoRA) to translate speech audio and text into those gesture tokens.

papers.title: MambaTalk: Efficient Holistic Gesture Synthesis with Selective State Space Models
papers.latency: 0.01917 s per second of gesture
papers.summary: Two-stage method that learns discrete motion codes for face, hands and body with VQ-VAEs, then predicts them from speech with selective state space (Mamba) models.
papers.notes: Mamba state space model is recorded as other. Face is predicted as FLAME parameters.

papers.title: Conversational Co-Speech Gesture Generation via Modeling Dialog Intention, Emotion, and Context with Diffusion Models
papers.summary: Diffusion model that generates gestures for a conversation participant from both speakers' audio and transcripts, with sentence-level dialog intention and emotion cues from a pretrained language model.

papers.title: Freetalker: Controllable Speech and Text-Driven Gesture Generation Based on Diffusion Models for Enhanced Speaker Naturalness
papers.summary: A diffusion model trained on unified representations of speech-driven gestures (BEAT) and text-driven motions (HumanML3D), with classifier-free guidance for style control and DoubleTake for blending clips.
papers.notes: Also reports SSIM.

papers.title: MDG:Multilingual Co-speech Gesture Generation with Low-level Audio Representation and Diffusion Models
papers.summary: Diffusion model for speech-driven gesture generation on a multilingual dataset, using a language ID and low-level audio features.

papers.title: Multimodal story-retelling
Audio2DiffuGesture: Generating a diverse co-speech gesture based on a diffusion model
papers.summary: A diffusion model that fuses raw-waveform and Mel-spectrogram audio features in a Transformer with cross-dimension attention to generate co-speech gestures.

papers.title: MMIDM: Generating 3D Gesture from Multimodal Inputs with Diffusion Models
GENEA Workshop 2024: The 5th Workshop on Generation and Evaluation of Non-verbal Behaviour for Embodied Agents
papers.summary: Workshop overview on generation and evaluation of non-verbal behaviour for embodied agents, aiming to unite the community around standardized benchmarking.

papers.title: Modifying Gesture Style with Impression Words
papers.summary: A GAN-based gesture style transfer model builds a style latent space from speaker videos, and a fine-tuned LLM selects a style from impression words.

papers.title: DiT-Gesture: A Speech-Only Approach to Stylized Gesture Generation
papers.summary: A diffusion-based non-autoregressive transformer with a WavLM audio encoder and a learnable dynamic mask attention that generates stylized full-body gestures from raw speech audio only.

papers.title: DR2: Disentangled Recurrent Representation Learning for Data-efficient Speech Video Synthesis
papers.summary: A disentangled recurrent representation learning framework synthesizes long, diverse full-body talking videos with co-speech gestures from about two minutes of training video.

papers.title: Embodying Similarity and Difference: The Effect of Listing and Contrasting Gestures During U.S. Political Speech
Learning hierarchical discrete prior for co-speech gesture generation
papers.summary: Two-stage hierarchical VQ-VAE codebook for gesture priors, with audio onset and text features mapped to codebook levels for audio-conditioned gesture generation.

papers.title: Speech-driven Personalized Gesture Synthetics: Harnessing Automatic Fuzzy Feature Inference
papers.summary: Generates personalized 3D full-body gestures from raw speech audio only, using a fuzzy feature extractor on WavLM features and an AdaLN transformer diffusion model.
papers.notes: Model name Persona-Gestor. Published version TVCG 2024 per candidate metadata; publisher DOI not seen.

papers.title: Semantic Gesticulator: Semantics-Aware Co-Speech Gesture Synthesis
papers.summary: Combines a GPT-based, RVQ token gesture generator matching speech rhythm with LLM-driven retrieval of semantic gestures from a motion library, aligned in latent space.
papers.notes: Other metric: semantic score. Introduces a motion-capture dataset of semantic gestures (SeG).

papers.title: A Unified Editing Method for Co-Speech Gesture Generation via Diffusion Inversion
papers.latency: About 500 ms for inversion (50 steps) plus 4000 ms for regeneration (1000 steps); noise optimization typically under 3 steps
papers.summary: Edits co-speech gestures without retraining by inverting a diffusion model to recover noise, then regenerating or optimizing the input noise under loss functions for joint rotation or velocity.
papers.notes: Built on DiffuseStyleGesture+. A published version exists under the DOI; its venue was not confirmed.

papers.title: Improving diversity of speech‐driven gesture generation with memory networks as dynamic dictionaries
papers.summary: Gesture generation in which a dictionary network stores text-to-pose key-value pairs as memory that the pose generation network looks up and merges with audio features.
papers.notes: Also proposes a new objective gesture diversity metric that removes the influence of low-quality motions.

papers.title: Co-speech gesture synthesis : Towards a controllable and interpretable model using a graph deterministic approach
papers.summary: STARGATE generates gestures autoregressively using CNN encoders for audio and text, an ST-GCN encoding the gesture history and a biRNN decoder, with a speaker embedding for style personalisation.
papers.notes: Abstract is in French; the thesis also extends the model to finger motion and multiple speakers and derives a gesture boundary detector from the adjacency matrices.

papers.title: Talking Hands, Shifting Tongues: How Does the Use of Co-speech Gestures and Second Language Relate to Emotional Autobiographical Memory Narration?
Expanding Multilingual Co-Speech Interaction: The Impact of Enhanced Gesture Units in Text-to-Gesture Synthesis for Digital Humans
papers.summary: Retrieves gesture units for input text from a rule base of about 210,000 rules built by matching 2D poses from video to 3D motion-capture gesture units with a contrastive pose-matching model, with translation for non-English text.
papers.notes: Preprint DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-3350470/v1 (Research Square, 2023). Title shown is the preprint title; the published IEEE Access title was not checked. Motion-capture gesture units come from Korean speakers.

papers.title: RIDGE: Rule-Infused Deep Learning for Realistic Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.latency: milliseconds per text segment, as stated; no benchmark table
papers.summary: Retrieves a motion-captured gesture from an LLM-built rule base when a text match is confident, and falls back to a contrastively trained text-gesture model otherwise.
papers.notes: Pre-trained on about 300 hours of pose-estimated online video before fine-tuning on BEAT.

papers.title: Co-speech gestures accompanying linguistic inventions
papers.venue: Publikationen an der Universität Bielefeld (Universität Bielefeld)

papers.title: Gestural Relativity of Spatial Cognition: Speakers’ co-speech gestures shape listeners’ spatial frame of reference
Gesture Use Contributes to Autobiographical Remembering
Co-speech gesture provides a window onto intraindividual conflict during embodied sensemaking
LLM-Driven Approach for Motion Control in Human-Robot Dialogue for Elevating Engagement
papers.summary: Compares two LLM-based robot motion controllers that generate body movements for utterances, one outputting joint angle parameters and one choosing primitive actions.

papers.title: Prosody and co-speech gestures in a Brazilian audiovisual spontaneous speech corpus: the case of Parentheticals
Gestures for me and you: A corpus study of Matukar Panau referential gestures
Co-Speech Hand Gestures Are Used to Predict Upcoming Meaning
Action depiction in gestures and signs
Beating stress: Evidence for recalibration of word stress perception
Promoting the integration of language, cognition and gesture for individuals with neurological disorders rehabilitation: A point of view and directions for future research
AnchorTalk: High-Fidelity Upper-Body Talking Human Generation From Speech
papers.summary: A tri-plane hash NeRF system that splits speech features into pose-related and head-related parts to drive body and head motion and render upper-body talking videos.

papers.title: Gestural Iconicity and Alignment as Steps in the Evolution of Language
Audio-driven Gesture Generation via Deviation Feature in the Latent Space
papers.summary: Learns weakly supervised latent motion deviations and uses a latent diffusion model to generate co-speech gesture videos from audio and a source image.

papers.title: The Language of Motion: Unifying Verbal and Non-verbal Language of 3D Human Motion
papers.summary: Tokenizes face, hand, upper-body and lower-body motion with VQ-VAEs and trains a multimodal language model on text, speech and motion, with pre-training for modality alignment and instruction-style post-training.
papers.notes: Also pre-trained on Librispeech audio-text. Metric listed as other covers BLEU, ROUGE, CIDEr and BERTScore.

papers.title: Motion-example-controlled Co-speech Gesture Generation Leveraging Large Language Models
papers.latency: 147 tokens per second with standard inference, 270 tokens per second with vLLM; about 36 seconds of motion generated per second
papers.summary: Fine-tunes a large language model on speech and motion tokens so that a motion example given in the prompt controls the style of generated gestures.
papers.notes: Accepts motion clips, static poses, video and text descriptions as examples; the project page lists code, pre-trained models and videos.

papers.title: TalkCuts: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multi-Shot Human Speech Video Generation
papers.summary: Dataset of 164k speech video clips (over 500 hours) with text descriptions, 2D keypoints and SMPL-X annotations, with an LLM-directed multi-shot video generation baseline (Orator).
papers.notes: Dataset released under CC BY 4.0, drawn from talk shows, TED talks and stand-up comedy videos. The DOI is from the candidate metadata; the published venue was not confirmed.

papers.title: Understanding and Generating Multi-Modalities: Advancing Efficient, Generalized, and Interactive Human-Centered AI
papers.summary: Doctoral thesis whose generation part presents a diffusion-based model producing synchronized, arbitrary-length holistic 3D facial expressions and body gestures from speech.
papers.notes: Thesis also covers video denoising, federated domain generalization and unified multimodal LLMs; only the speech-to-gesture part is in scope. Abstract claims real-time generation but gives no figure.

papers.title: Conditional GAN for Enhancing Diffusion Models in Efficient and Authentic Global Gesture Generation from Audios
papers.latency: average runtime of 5 ms and 4.6 ms per frame (about 12x faster than DiffStyleGesture)
papers.summary: Uses a conditional GAN inside the diffusion sampling step so that larger noise steps and fewer denoising steps can be used for audio-driven full-body gesture generation.

papers.title: DIDiffGes: Decoupled Semi-Implicit Diffusion Models for Real-time Gesture Generation from Speech
papers.latency: 88 frames of gesture motion in 0.4 s with 10 sampling steps
papers.summary: Generates full-body gestures from speech with a diffusion model whose large denoising steps are modelled by a GAN, decoupling body and hands into marginal and conditional distributions.
papers.notes: Also evaluated on music-to-dance data (AIST++).

papers.title: HoleGest: Decoupled Diffusion and Motion Priors for Generating Holisticly Expressive Co-Speech Gestures
papers.latency: 0.88 seconds to generate a 2-second gesture sequence
papers.summary: Decoupled diffusion denoisers for upper body, lower body and fingers, with semi-implicit constraints for fewer sampling steps and pretrained motion priors, generate SMPL-X gestures from audio with a gesture-text shared embedding for semantics.
papers.notes: Other metrics reported: Skate, Float and a proposed Semantic Alignment score. Additional prior datasets: 100STYLE and SignAvatars. Project page lists the title as HoloGest.

papers.title: HOP: Heterogeneous Topology-based Multimodal Entanglement for Co-Speech Gesture Generation
papers.summary: A bidirectional GRU generator trained adversarially produces upper-body gestures from audio and text, using a graph encoder for audio-motion alignment and a reprogramming module for audio-text fusion.

papers.title: Evaluation of Generative Models for Emotional 3D Animation Generation in VR
papers.summary: Compares three speech-driven 3D animation methods (EMAGE, TalkSHOW, AMUSE with FaceFormer) and a video-reconstruction baseline in a VR human-agent scenario with a 48-participant study of emotion and animation quality.

papers.title: VLOGGER: Multimodal Diffusion for Embodied Avatar Synthesis
papers.summary: Generates talking human video from a single image and audio or text by predicting 3D face and body motion with a diffusion model, then rendering frames with a motion-conditioned image diffusion model.

papers.title: Advancing Objective Evaluation of Speech-Driven Gesture Generation for Embodied Conversational Agents
papers.summary: Proposes neural feature extractors for similarity-based objective evaluation and compares 56 combinations of extractors and distance measures by their correlation with GENEA 2022 and 2023 subjective results.
papers.notes: Best reported combination is a CNN trained on motion-audio sync classification with Fréchet distance (correlation 0.809).

papers.title: Controllable Speech-Driven Gesture Generation with Selective Activation of Weakly Supervised Controls
papers.summary: Cont-Gest is a Transformer gesture generator with selectively activatable controls (velocity, hand height, emotion) via masked training and a control fusion strategy such as FiLM.
papers.notes: Objective evaluation uses the Kinetic-Hellinger distance; also proposes an evaluation-driven development workflow.

papers.title: Stereo-Talker: Audio-driven 3D Human Synthesis with Prior-Guided Mixture-of-Experts
papers.summary: Two-stage audio-driven human video synthesis that maps audio to upper-body and facial motion with an LLM-prior diffusion model, then renders video with a mixture-of-experts diffusion model.
papers.notes: Introduces a 2,203-identity video dataset (HDAV); authors state code, data and weights will be released.

papers.title: Early parental multimodal input is differentially associated with later vocabulary knowledge for preterm and full-term infants
Iconic gesture use during discourse production in latent aphasia
Synthetically Expressive: Evaluating gesture and voice for emotion and empathy in VR and 2D scenarios
papers.summary: A user study with 219 participants compares real and synthetic (AMUSE) gestures and voices in VR and 2D displays across emotional contexts.

papers.title: Diffusion Transformer Framework for Speech-Driven Stylized Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Encodes speech audio and an example style gesture with dual-stream audio and style encoders, fuses them by cross-attention and generates stylized gestures with a latent diffusion module.

papers.title: How a modality-neutral prosodic dimension can enrich the multimodal language acquisition framework: A commentary on Karadöller, Sümer and Özyürek
SemGest: A Multimodal Feature Space Alignment and Fusion Framework for Semantic-aware Co-speech Gesture Generation
papers.venue: International Workshop on Generation and Evaluation of Non-verbal Behaviour for Embodied Agents
papers.summary: Aligns semantic features from the transcript with gesture space, fuses them with speech features, and conditions a diffusion model on the fused features to generate 3D body gestures.

papers.title: TranSTYLer: Multimodal behavioural style transfer for facial and body gestures generation
papers.summary: A multimodal transformer with style-content disentanglement that transfers a target speaker's behaviour style onto a source speaker's text and speech to produce 2D upper-body and facial landmark motion.
papers.notes: Fields read from the arXiv version (2308.10843); the published journal version may differ. Skeleton has 11 upper-body joints and 15 facial landmarks, no fingers. PATS was extended with dialogue acts and 2D facial landmarks. Other metrics: transfer strength accuracy and content preservation.

papers.title: Towards More Expressive Human-Robot Interactions: Combining Latent Representations and Diffusion Models for Co-speech Gesture Generation
Evaluating the effect of co-speech gesture prediction on Human–Robot Interaction
papers.summary: A within-subjects study comparing a robot that selects non-verbal expressions with a co-speech gesture prediction module against one that uses random expressions, played over a card game.

papers.title: Predicting and Synchronising Co-Speech Gestures for Enhancing Human–Robot Interactions Using Deep Learning Models
papers.latency: Average end-to-end execution time of about 0.67 to 1.02 s across approaches with remote processing
papers.summary: Labels a robot's utterances with gesture types using LSTM-CRF or fine-tuned transformer classifiers, then a rule-based module synchronises the selected gestures with speech chunks.
papers.notes: Gesture labels are predicted, not motion; gestures are played on a tabletop robot with five joints. Dataset of 2,600 utterances from the Cornell Movie Dialogs Corpus with 21 gesture and 28 intention labels. Metrics are F-score, precision, recall and accuracy of label prediction. A 15-participant validation of gesture-utterance matching was run, but no user study of the system.

papers.title: Simultaneous text and gesture generation for social robots with small language models
papers.summary: Adds lightweight robot-specific gesture heads to a small language model so that high-level communicative intentions are predicted in parallel with text and mapped to Furhat and Pepper expressions.
papers.notes: Predicts high-level communicative intentions mapped to platform-specific expressions, not joint trajectories. Evaluated on SODA dialogues with synthetically generated gesture labels; metrics are error rate, accuracy, F1 and overlap. Edge speed (e.g. 5.47 tokens/s for an 8B int4 model on a Jetson) is for text generation.

papers.title: Ges-QA: A Multidimensional Quality Assessment Dataset for Audio-to-3D Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Builds a dataset of 1,400 generated 3D gesture samples with human ratings of gesture quality and audio-gesture consistency and trains a three-branch (video, audio, skeleton) network to predict them.
papers.notes: Ges-QA samples come from six existing audio-to-gesture generators on BEAT2; quality-prediction metrics are SRCC, PLCC, KRCC and RMSE.

papers.title: SARGes: Semantically Aligned Reliable Gesture Generation via Intent Chain
papers.latency: 0.4 s per inference for the fine-tuned label generator (about 3 s with GPT-4)
papers.summary: Uses an LLM with intent-chain reasoning over a gesture ethogram to turn speech text into semantic gesture labels, then a LoRA-fine-tuned Qwen model generates the labels that guide gesture synthesis.
papers.notes: Generates gesture labels from text; the metric is a partial-overlap label accuracy. Published version has a DOI under ACM (10.1145/3746268.3759436); venue not confirmed from the text read.

papers.title: Translating audio into movement: A semantic gesture generation approach using conditional GANs
Large Language Models for Virtual Human Gesture Selection
papers.latency: 6.51-9.29 seconds per utterance for the full system; 1.08-1.23 seconds with optimized queries
papers.summary: Prompts GPT-4 with gestural intent descriptions and annotated examples to choose meaningful hand gestures and their timing for an utterance, output as BML for a virtual agent.
papers.notes: Evaluated by two expert annotators on about 6 minutes of annotated video of one speaker; output is gesture selection in Behavior Markup Language rather than raw motion.

papers.title: How Children With and Without Developmental Language Disorder Use Prosody and Gestures to Process Phrasal Ambiguities
Prosody and gestures help pragmatic processing in children with Developmental Language Disorder
From Embeddings to Language Models: A Comparative Analysis of Feature Extractors for Text-Only and Multimodal Gesture Generation
papers.summary: Compares seven diffusion-based gesture generation pipelines that use different audio (WavLM, Whisper) and text (Word2Vec, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct) feature extractors.

papers.title: The Impact of Gestures on the Perception of Creative Linguistic Constructions by Humans and Virtual Agents - Experiment 2
Evaluating Automatic Hand-Gesture Generation Using Multimodal Corpus Annotations: The Benefits of a Multidisciplinary Approach
papers.venue: International Workshop on Generation and Evaluation of Non-verbal Behaviour for Embodied Agents
papers.summary: Compares expert annotations of natural and synthetic hand gestures on a small dataset to derive indicators of communicative efficiency and movement dynamics for evaluating gesture synthesis.

papers.title: The ECOLANG Multimodal Corpus of adult-child and adult-adult Language
AudCast: Audio-Driven Human Video Generation by Cascaded Diffusion Transformers
papers.summary: Generates holistic human videos from a reference image and audio with a cascade of diffusion transformers, a whole-body DiT followed by a regional refinement DiT for hands and face.
papers.notes: Output also includes body movement in video; other metrics are FID-VID, Body-C, Hand-C, Hand-V and identity cosine similarity. Training set is about 300 hours of speaking-human video; PATS clips used in testing.

papers.title: FastTalker: Jointly Generating Speech and Conversational Gestures from Text
papers.latency: 0.17 seconds per second of output on an NVIDIA 3090
papers.summary: Generates speech waveforms and full-body gestures from a text script in one network, reusing intermediate speech-synthesis features (pitch, energy, duration) to drive a gesture decoder over VQ codes.
papers.notes: Also reports UTMOS and CMOS for the synthesized speech. The proceedings volume appeared in 2025; the ECCV workshop took place in 2024.

papers.title: How Gesture Benefits Learning: A Working Framework for Examining Attention and Memory Mechanisms
Toward Unified Co-Speech Gesture Generation via Hierarchical Implicit Periodicity Learning
papers.summary: Disentangles gesture motion with periodic autoencoders and drives face, body and hands with cascaded hierarchical guidance to generate 3D gestures from audio.

papers.title: Co-speech Gestures
A richly annotated dataset of co-speech hand gestures across diverse speaker contexts
papers.summary: A dataset of 2373 manually annotated co-speech hand gestures from nine English-speaking lecturers, politicians and psychotherapists, with gesture types, physical properties, lexemes and MediaPipe 3D pose tracking.
papers.notes: GESRes dataset on OSF (10.17605/OSF.IO/9ZKFM); annotations CC BY, videos CC BY-NC-SA; 3 h 46 min of footage from 12 videos.

papers.title: Joint Co-Speech Gesture and Expressive Talking Face Generation using Diffusion with Adapters
papers.summary: A single diffusion network with adapters and shared transformer weights generates upper-body gesture and facial motion jointly from speech audio.
papers.notes: Also reports Frechet Expression Distance and parameter counts.

papers.title: A Review of Digital Human Gesture Generation Technology and Its Teaching Application Thinking
papers.summary: Reviews co-speech gesture generation methods and datasets and discusses applications of the technology in education.

papers.title: FastTalker: Co-Speech Gesture Generation via Fast-Order Diffusion ODE Solver
papers.venue: Communications in Computer and Information Science

papers.title: Inter-Diffusion Generation Model of Speakers and Listeners for Effective Communication
papers.summary: Generates full-body gestures for both speaker and listener with a dual-branch diffusion model using cross attention between the two, with a GAN to enlarge the denoising step.
papers.notes: Authors state the DDPM-based model may not suit real-time applications.

papers.title: Contrastive negation constructions in Israeli Hebrew
Impact of Personality on Generation of Co-speech Nonverbal Behaviors Represented by 3D Skeleton Pose
papers.summary: Predicts 3D upper-body skeleton coordinates (head, arms, posture) from speech, text and Big Five personality scores, trained on a newly built multimodal dialogue corpus.
papers.notes: Also takes Big Five personality scores as input (no matching input value). Venue name not stated in the text read; ACM proceedings DOI.

papers.title: Generation of Listening Motion of Embodied Conversational Agents Using Speech and Text Information
papers.venue: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems

papers.title: Cloze test: Co-speech hand gestures are used to predict upcoming meaning
Speaking Beyond Language: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Learning Nonverbal Cues from Video-Grounded Dialogues
papers.summary: A multimodal language model that predicts text interleaved with vector-quantized FLAME face and SMPL-X upper-body tokens by next-token prediction, trained on the VENUS dataset of podcast videos.
papers.notes: Also introduces the VENUS dataset (14,910 hours reported). Other metrics: perplexity, BERT-score, METEOR, NLL on nonverbal tokens.

papers.title: Embodied Polysemiotic Communication: A Cognitive Semiotic Perspective on Speech and Gestures
papers.venue: Numanities - arts and humanities in progress

papers.title: Let Them Talk: Audio-Driven Multi-Person Conversational Video Generation
papers.summary: Generates multi-person conversational video from multiple audio streams with a video diffusion transformer, binding each audio stream to its person via label rotary position embeddings.

papers.title: Memories of hand movements are tied to speech through learning
Adults interpret iconicity in speech and gesture via the same modality-independent process
